title: Authentication Services for FISMA Support
description: INTRODUCTION AND BACKGROUND This is a Sources Sought Notice (SSN) issued by the Treasury Common Services Center (TCSC), Acquisition Services, on behalf of the Bureau of the Fiscal Service (Fiscal Service), Identity, Credentialing & Access Management (ICAM) Division. The purpose of this notice is to obtain industry information and identify 8(a) sources that are both capable of and interested in providing commercial Engineer and Project Management Services for the execution of Authentication Services for Federal Information Security Modernization Action (FISMA) Support as described herein. This information is being sought for acquisition planning purposes only. SCOPE AND OBJECTIVES Fiscal Services is seeking to identify Contractors who can provide highly skilled and technical contractual support for Information System Security Officer (ISSO) duties and audit liaison for the Authentication Services General Support System (AS GSS). Subject Matter Expert (SME) Contractor support shall include assistance in the development, maintenance, and oversight of the Authentication Services FISMA system, including Security Controls, Continuity of Operations, plans, and related exercises surrounding access to Fiscal Service IT resources. Contractor resources also support the management and response to user access issues and problems within the ICAM Division for the AS GSS system and its sub-components. The Contractor shall perform all Authentication Services; FISMA related tasks generally assigned to an Information System Security Officer and all related Identity, Credentialing, and Access Management Security audit tasks include: Provide, monitor, and manage the AS GSS as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO). This includes the creation, management, and maintenance of all FISMA lifecycle tasks, deliverables, and continuous monitoring indicator tasks within the Government, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tool. Review, develop and maintain documentation of ICAM processes, procedures, and operations pertaining to providing and managing user access to Fiscal Service IT Resources via the AS GSS. Provide expert guidance, training, and assistance with the closure of issues discovered during Vulnerability Scanning. Perform Audit Liaison activities for the various Audits and Assessments that are conducted against Authentication Services and Central Authentication and Identity Assurance (CAIA) fronted applications. This includes the Schedule of the Federal Debt, Consolidated Financial Statement, Office of Inspector General (OIG) and Government Accountability Office (GAO) audits. Support and Maintain ICAM Organization and Identity Administration functions: ICAM Operations and Help Desk Respond to ICAM program and daily operational needs Maintain and monitor the PKI, LDAP, SSO, Splunk, Vault and CAIA service for ICAM Liaison with the AS application and service users Liaison with other FS and FRB ISSO�s and System Owners Authentication Services Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Support User Provisioning Administration, reconciliation and reporting: Create and maintain Authentication Services in-boundary and service user Policies, Standards and Procedures. Review and act upon issues seen on the Authentication Services transaction Logs via Enterprise Log Management (Splunk). Manage and review access reconciliation and recertification policies, standards and procedures for all aspects of the AS GSS. The Contractor shall participate with ongoing cloud migration initiatives, assisting with all access and security controls to ensure optimal security posture and compliance with National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Treasury and Fiscal Service IT Security Standards and Business Line Security Requirements (BLSRs). The Contractor shall provide training for personnel on IT related subjects centering on NIST regulatory requirements. Conduct the ICAM Technical Support (DTS) Contract Status Meeting Develop ICAM Technical Support (DTS) Contract Status Report Perform Fiscal Service Authentication Services FISMA ISSO Duties and Reporting Inventory Record of Government Furnished Property

title: Golf Course Driving Range at Ramstein Air Base, Germany
description: This requirement will be solicited among local European sources that can meet the customer's needs listed below. Statement of Needs for Golf Course Driving Range/Woodlawn Driving Range: 1.0 Requirement: Install golf ball tracking technology at the driving range all (18 bays) to provide customers with real time data for practicing/playing purposes. Contractor will install the minimum required cameras/radars to capture data for the entire driving range operating at full capacity. Contractor will install monitors at each bay (18) in an area that is easily viewable by customers but out of the way and protected by the weather. Contactor will install wire tracks as needed, reducing the number of exposed wires. Contractor will return the facility to the same condition as it was before installation began. Contractor will be able to provide a virtual rendering of Woodlawn Golf Course for virtual playing. 1.1 Golf course provides the following: Install power and internet drops in each bay (18). Trenching for power/data cables. Access to the work location during the hours of operation: Monday � Friday, 0600 � 1800 hours. Weekend hours to be discussed as needed.

This contracting action is being pursued on a sole-source basis under the statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 6.302-1, 'Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements.' description: The purpose of this Source Sought notice is for market research to identify interested and capability alternative sources for performing mathematical algorithm development and computational analysis in support of Missile Defense Agency (MDA) flight tests. All responses received will be considered for meeting the MDA�s requirements and determination of final acquisition strategy for the follow-on contract to HQ085122D0002. Eligibility to participate in any future acquisition does not depend upon a response to this notice. The MDA does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this notice or pay for the information requested. Responses to this notice will be treated as information only and not a proposal. Background: The MDA is responsible for developing and fielding an integrated, layered Missile Defense System (MDS) to protect the United States and its allies from missile attack by providing homeland and regional missile defense. The MDS layered approach includes sensors, kinetic energy systems, directed energy systems, battle management, and command control elements that will engage threats at all ranges and throughout the battlespace. Description: This is a follow-on requirement in support of various programs within the MDA within the Aegis Based Defense (AB) portfolio. The respondents to this request should have the ability to provide equipment and personnel for mathematical algorithm development and analyses for the Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense program, to include current and future capabilities, as identified below. Mathematical Algorithm development and analyses including development and delivery of post intercept debris generation and dynamic behavior models for multi-threaded and massively parallel multi-processor supercomputing systems. Threat Engagement Debris and Kill Assessment Analysis Pre-mission and post mission analysis of flight test event high strain rate, material deformation, projection and trajectory simulations (Velodyne, hydro-structural solver brand name or equal software analysis tool), RavenCFD and related analyses in support of Flight Test Missions and events. Support Test and Evaluation Working Groups meetings as needed Engagement in mission planning and mission analysis reviews The MDA is seeking sources with experience in high fidelity engineering and mathematical analyses to support MDA flight test events. Analyses include development and delivery of post intercept debris generation and dynamic behavior models for multi-threaded and massively parallel supercomputing systems to support pre and post mission planning, test execution, and data collection/analysis. Provide support for integration of algorithms into existing MDA models to include the following: Mission specific model development Target assessment, interceptor assessment, engagement assessment, mission risk assessment, and data collections. The awardee of the future contract to fulfill this requirement must be able to travel Continental United States (CONUS) and Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS) in support of each MDA�s flight test events and analysis support. The MDA will provide the awardee information in the form of design specifications, user manuals, operations guides, as build drawings, intelligence information, and briefing packages on the Standard Missile-3 and Standard Missile-6 missiles (including successor missiles or similar flight test event requirements) and on targets of interest, at time of requirement as available. title: AZ BL COLO 7528(1) Burro Creek Road
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Burro Creek Road is located in Mohave County, 71 miles southwest of Kingman, Arizona. The project is located in rolling terrain, with elevations along this section ranging from approximately 1,885 to 2,255 feet. The project begins at the bridge over Burro Creek and ends at the cattle guard near the intersection with US Hwy 93. The project's length is approximately 1.3 miles. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The proposed of this resurfacing, restoration, and rehabilitation (3R) project is to improve access to the camping and day use areas at the Burro Creek Campground, reduce maintenance costs and erosion, improve sediment control, drainage and safety. The scope of work for this project includes the following major construction activities and items: Pavement Rehabilitation: 1.3 miles of roadway resurfacing incorporating Full Depth Reclamation (FDR) and Asphalt Concrete Pavement, along with applicable fog seals and tack coats. Drainage Improvements: Installation of cross culverts and reconstruction of an existing headwall. Additional drainage work includes ditch grading and reconditioning, berms, bank stabilization, and the addition of flared end sections and riprap aprons throughout the project. Earthwork & Stabilization: Embankment benching, slope stabilization, slope scaling, and specific bridge approach repairs at the eastern abutment to resolve undercutting concerns Safety & Traffic Control Items: Installation of new regulatory and warning signs, pavement markings and the placement of boulders to control public access at specific locations throughout the project. The project is structured with a base Schedule A encompassing the primary roadway rehabilitation, and an Option X which includes work associated with repairing bridge sedimentation, addressing undercutting at the bridge approaches, and boulder placement. PRINCIPAL WORK ITEMS: Roadway Aggregate: 1,600 TONS Ditch Reconditioning: 2,000 LNFT Full Depth Reclamation: 1.3 MILE Asphalt Concrete Pavement: 3,600 TON 18-Inch Pipe Culvert: 100 LNFT 24-Inch Pipe Culvert: 175 LNFT Boulder: 100 EACH ANTICIPATED SCHEDULE: Advertisement � October 2026 Award-January - 2027 Construction � January 2027 through October 2027 ESTIMATED COST RANGE: Between $2,000,000 and $5,000,000

title: AZ BL COLO 7528(1) Burro Creek Road
description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Burro Creek Road is located in Mohave County, 71 miles southwest of Kingman, Arizona. The project is located in rolling terrain, with elevations along this section ranging from approximately 1,885 to 2,255 feet. The project begins at the bridge over Burro Creek and ends at the cattle guard near the intersection with US Hwy 93. The project's length is approximately 1.3 miles. SCOPE OF THE WORK: The proposed of this resurfacing, restoration, and rehabilitation (3R) project is to improve access to the camping and day use areas at the Burro Creek Campground, reduce maintenance costs and erosion, improve sediment control, drainage and safety. The scope of work for this project includes the following major construction activities and items: Pavement Rehabilitation: 1.3 miles of roadway resurfacing incorporating Full Depth Reclamation (FDR) and Asphalt Concrete Pavement, along with applicable fog seals and tack coats. Drainage Improvements: Installation of cross culverts and reconstruction of an existing headwall. Additional drainage work includes ditch grading and reconditioning, berms, bank stabilization, and the addition of flared end sections and riprap aprons throughout the project. Earthwork & Stabilization: Embankment benching, slope stabilization, slope scaling, and specific bridge approach repairs at the eastern abutment to resolve undercutting concerns Safety & Traffic Control Items: Installation of new regulatory and warning signs, pavement markings and the placement of boulders to control public access at specific locations throughout the project. The project is structured with a base Schedule A encompassing the primary roadway rehabilitation, and an Option X which includes work associated with repairing bridge sedimentation, addressing undercutting at the bridge approaches, and boulder placement. PRINCIPAL WORK ITEMS: Roadway Aggregate: 1,600 TONS Ditch Reconditioning: 2,000 LNFT Full Depth Reclamation: 1.3 MILE Asphalt Concrete Pavement: 3,600 TON 18-Inch Pipe Culvert: 100 LNFT 24-Inch Pipe Culvert: 175 LNFT Boulder: 100 EACH ANTICIPATED SCHEDULE: Advertisement � October 2026 Award-January - 2027 Construction � January 2027 through October 2027 ESTIMATED COST RANGE: Between $2,000,000 and $5,000,000

title: Germany – Electrical wiring and fitting work – Modernisierung GS Dorschbergschule - Elektroinstallation
description: Die Grundschule Dorschberg in Wörth a. Rh. wurde 1966 baulich errichtet und liegt hinter dem Mittelbau der Carl–Benz–Gesamtschule in Wörth am Rhein. Die Grundschule besteht aus vier Gebäudeteilen, zu welchen ein ein- bzw. zweigeschossiger Gebäudeteil mit Verbindungsgängen gehört sowie eine Pausenhalle mit einem Verwaltungstrakt und einem eingeschossigen Pavillonbau mit vier Pavillongebäuden. Die Gebäude sind mit Pausengängen verbunden und verfügen über zwei Toilettengebäude. Die ein- bis zweigeschossigen Gebäude wurden in massiver Bauweise mit Beton-Fertigteilen errichtet und weisen Flachdächer in unterschiedlichen Höhenlagen mit umlaufender Attika auf und wurden bis heute mehrfach saniert und modernisiert. Mitte der 1990er Jahre fand eine Betonsanierung statt. In diesem Zuge wurde ein Wärmedämm-Verbundsystem und die Alucobond-Verkleidungen der Attiken und der Fertigteilstützen angebracht. Wesentliche bauliche Maßnahmen - Der bestehende eingeschossige Klassentrakt wird aufgestockt und der bisherige Innenhofbereich zwischen den beiden bestehenden Klassentrakten wird geschlossen und überdacht. Hierzu wird die nicht ausreichend tragfähige Spannbetondecke über dem nördlichen Klassentakt zurück gebaut und durch eine neue Stahlbeton-Massivdecke ersetzt. - Das neue Obergeschoss wird in vorgefertigter Holzbauweise mit tragenden Wänden als Massivholzkonstruktion bzw. Holzständerkonstruktion und oberster Geschossdecke als Brettsperrholzkonstruktion errichtet. - Die zentrale Aula wird mit einer Glasdachkonstruktion versehen. - Die Spannbetondecke im Flurbereich über dem bestehenden Kriechkeller des Nordtraktes muss durch Stahlträger ertüchtigt werden. - Kleinteilige Grundrissänderungen im Bestand - Die Pavillons werden entkernt und zur erweiterten überdachten Pausenhoffläche - Verbesserung des Wärmeschutzes sämtlicher Gebäudehüllflächen (Dachflächen, Fenster, hinterlüftete Holzfassaden, Kellerdeckendämmung) - Modernisierung der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung inkl. kontrollierten Lüftungseinrichtung mit Wärmerückgewinnung, energiesparender Beleuchtungssysteme, Gebäudeautomation, einschließlich der digitalen Anforderungen an Schulgebäude - Optimierung des Brandschutzes und Umsetzung des schulischen Schutzkonzepts

title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – BD26006 Dienstplanungssoftware für die Feuerwehr Karlsruhe
description: Die Branddirektion Karlsruhe beschäftigt ca. 350 Mitarbeitende, die in mindestens zehn unterschiedlichen Dienstplanungs- und Arbeitszeitmodellen beschäftigt werden. Die aktuelle Dienstplanung für die Beamten des Einsatzdienstes auf den Feuerwachen und der Integrierten Leitstelle erfolgt in selbst entwickelten Access-Datenbanken, die in der Branddirektion Karlsruhe programmiert und gewartet werden. Für den Bereich der Dienstplanung der Führungsdienste existiert aktuell keine Softwarelösung. Sie wird händisch geführt, was einen erheblichen Zusatzaufwand verursacht. Die Mitarbeitenden im reinen Tagdienst erfassen ihre Stunden ebenfalls über eine Excel-Lösung. Eine Prozessunterstützung ist nicht gegeben. Die bisherigen Datenbanken sind nicht rechtssicher. Die Grundsätze des Datenschutzes und der Datensicherheit können nicht eingehalten werden. Mit der Beschaffung und dem Einsatz einer Dienstplanungssoftware für die Branddirektion soll die Ablösung der bisherigen Access-Dienstplansoftware sowie der Access-Lösung zur Ermittlung des Entgelts für den Dienst zu ungünstigen Zeiten erfolgen. Die Erfassung aller Dienstzeiten der Mitarbeitenden der Branddirektion sollen über eine Software erfolgen. Die mehrmals täglich wechselnde Funktionseinteilung des Einsatzdienstes soll über die Software in Echtzeit abgebildet werden können. Diese Einteilung soll auch Drittanwendungen zur Verfügung stehen. Der Datenschutz und die Datensicherheit sollen gewährleistet sein. Arbeitszeit- und Urlaubsprozesse sollen transparent und ohne Medienbruch abgebildet werden. Für die Mitarbeitenden soll hierfür eine App zur Verfügung stehen. Die auszahlungsrelevanten Daten inklusive Zuschlägen und Sonderzahlungen werden an SAP übergeben. Eine moderne Dienstplanungssoftware soll mit maximaler Flexibilität auf Veränderungen reagieren können, um den Betrieb und die Einsatzfähigkeit der Feuerwehr Karlsruhe zu jeder Zeit garantieren zu können. Die Einführung der neuen Softwarelösung erfolgt im laufenden Betrieb. Es sind bereits mehrere Vorprojekte erfolgreich durchgeführt worden, um die Anforderungen an die komplexe Dienstplanung des Schichtdienstes der Einsatzbeamten vorab zu skizzieren. Parallel werden die Kernprozesse bereits vormodelliert. Der Go Live Zeitpunkt muss mit der Urlaubsplanung, welche im September für das kommende Jahr startet, abgestimmt werden, um die Datenübertragung zu vereinfachen. Anzustreben ist der Go Live zum Jahreswechsel 2027 auf 2028. Die Software soll on premise bei der Stadt Karlsruhe innerhalb der städtischen IT-Infrastrukur betrieben werden. Die Software soll gemietet werden. Alle weiteren Informationen und Anforderungen sind den Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

title: Bulgaria – Pharmaceutical products – „Доставка на лекарствени продукти за нуждите на „МБАЛ – Благоевград“ АД за срок от 36 месеца
description: „Доставка на лекарствени продукти за нуждите на „МБАЛ – Благоевград“ АД, за срок от 36 месеца. ДСП - Доставка на лекарствени продукти съгасно първоначално планиран спектър /част от документацията за участие/ с посочено естество на продуктите, прогнозна стойност, както и посочено прогнозно количество. Първоначално планиранираният спектър може да бъде частично изменен, както и да се добавят нови продукти в хода на динамичната система. Количествата са ориентировъчни. Възложителят не e длъжен да изкупи посочените в спектъра количества. Одобрените кандидати могат да подадат оферта за една или повече единици, както и могат да не подадат оферта. ДСП функционира на два етапа: Първи етап - събиране на заявления за участие и Втори етап - събиране на оферти по конкретни покани. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 15 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на заявления. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички заявления. Офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще е достъпна и безплатна за всички кандидати. Осигурен е неограничен, пълен и пряк достъп до документацията за обществената поръчка през целия срок на действие на ДСП. ДСП ще функционира в рамките на три години, а именно в рамките на три години възложителят може да отправя покани до допуснатите кандидати за събиране на оферти за доставка на лекарствени продукти, включени в първоначално планираният спектър или извън него. Слючените договори ще са със срок на действие: 12 месеца.

description: THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. The effort will include but not limit the scope of work to upgrade 25 Depot and Production test stations computer Operating System (OS) for NISPOM Windows 11 compliance as mandated by DCSA. The upgrades are required to keep APG-79 test stations compliant for DCSA Authorization to Operate (ATO) as they are used by Industry in the testing of production and repaired AESA APG-79(V)1, (V)4 and FMS radars and radar components. The station upgrades are for three (3) phases containing 5-11 stations per phase. Upgrades to Capital stations include program specific software changes, test procedure updates, and Integration / Verification & Validation with the Radar / WRAs. All stations reside at Raytheon and prospective contractors are responsible for gaining access to Raytheon facilities and obtaining the proprietary data necessary to support the system upgrades. Disclaimer & Important Notes This is a Request for Information (RFI) / Sources Sought notice only. This notice is issued solely for information, planning, and market research purposes in accordance with FAR 15.201(e). It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or an invitation for bid. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this RFI or to otherwise pay for the information solicited. Respondents are advised that the U.S. Government will not be responsible for any costs incurred in preparing or submitting a response to this notice. All submissions will become Government property and will not be returned. Security & Technical Drawing Access Notice: To maintain operational security, no engineering drawings, CAD models, or technical data packages will be uploaded or publicly released during this initial market research phase. The technical sourcing parameters in Section 2 provide sufficient industrial detail for facilities to assess their capabilities. During the subsequent formal solicitation phase, the complete, certified Technical Data Package (TDP)�including all JCG230321 engineering drawings and 3D CAD SolidWorks/STEP/IGES models�will be fully provided under secure DLA Joint Certification Program (JCP) verification to all qualified bidders. 2. Technical Sourcing Profile The Department of the Air Force, 309th Aircraft Maintenance Group (AMXG), 575th AMXS, Randolph AFB, TX, is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of manufacturing, fabricating, and delivering: Item Description: T-38 CFS 505 Drill Fixtures Kit (Precision drill fixture plate, custom-molded transport case, and corresponding accessories) Design Specification: Fabricated to Drawing Configuration JCG230321 Quantity: Five (5) Configuration Sets Required Lead Time: Three (3) Months / 90 Calendar Days from contract award (Critical Path) FOB Point: FOB Destination (851 4th St West Bldg 241, Randolph AFB, TX 78150) Salient Technical & Manufacturing Parameters: Envelope Dimensions: Approximately 14" Length x 10" Width x 6" Height (to be stored in a custom three-layer foam insert within a Pelican Model 1400 Protector Case). Material Requirements: High-strength tool steels (e.g., A2, D2, or pre-hardened 4140 alloys) requiring precision heat-treatment, stress-relieving, and black oxide or equivalent corrosion-resistant coating. Machining Operations: Substantive multi-axis CNC vertical milling, wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining), and precision surface grinding to hold dimensional tolerances down to $\pm$ 0.001 inches on critical interface bores. Packaging, Cushioning, and 3-Layer Kitting: The Pelican Model 1400 case must be configured with three (3) distinct, stacked, and nested layers of precision CNC-cut or water-jet cut, closed-cell polyethylene foam (no pick-and-pluck allowed): Layer 1 (Top Layer): Custom-cut pockets contoured for A and D Holes on the fuselage and boattail sides. Layer 2 (Middle Layer): Custom-cut pockets contoured for B Holes on the fuselage and boattail sides. Layer 3 (Bottom Layer): Custom-cut pockets contoured for C Holes on the fuselage and boattail sides. Each layer shall feature high-contrast lettering identifying components and center finger pulls/tabs for easy lifting. 3. Critical Sourcing & Quality Parameters Buy American & Specialty Metals: This requirement is subject to the Buy American statute (41 U.S.C. Chapter 83) as implemented by FAR Part 25 and DFARS Part 225. In accordance with DFARS 252.225-7009, any specialty metals (including tool steels) used to fabricate the drill fixtures must be melted or produced within the United States or a qualifying allied country. First Article Inspection (FAI): Unless the selected contractor is the original manufacturer or has previously fabricated this exact fixture for the USAF, a First Article Inspection in accordance with AS9102 and a certified CMM dimensional calibration sheet will be required prior to full-scale production. 4. Capability Statement Submission Requirements Interested and capable manufacturing firms are requested to submit a Capability Statement (not exceeding 4 pages) addressing the following: Company Profile: Company Name, Physical Address, CAGE Code, UEI, active Joint Certification Program (JCP) Number (DD Form 2345), and Small Business socio-economic status. Machining Competency: Describe your facility's in-house equipment (e.g., multi-axis CNC mills, wire EDM, surface grinders, and Coordinate Measuring Machines) and your experience holding tolerances of $\pm$ 0.001 inches on tool steel. Past Performance: Provide up to three (3) examples of similar high-tolerance aerospace assembly tooling, drill jigs, or flight-critical fixtures manufactured by your firm within the last 3 years. Lead Time Feasibility: Confirm whether your firm can source raw specialty steels, program tooling paths, fabricate, perform heat treatment, and deliver 5 completed assemblies within 90 calendar days of contract award. If 90 days is not feasible, provide your best realistic lead time. Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM): Provide a non-binding estimated cost range for fabricating 5 units of the drill fixture kit. If possible, please break down estimated machining labor hours versus raw material costs. Submission Email: joshua.akinwande.2@us.af.mil Submission Deadline: November 17, 2026, by 1500 MST Email Subject Line: RFI Response: T-38 CFS 505 Drill Fixtures - [Your Company Name]

title: Aircraft Coatings and Sealants OO-ALC
description: The Ogden Air Logistics Complex (OO-ALC) at Hill Air Force Base, Utah, has a need to contract for comprehensive management and supply of aircraft coatings and sealants. This effort aims to ensure uninterrupted aircraft maintenance operations through robust inventory management, timely delivery, and technical support. This effort will include frequent ordering and quick delivery of specified items. The selected contractor will be responsible for continuous deliveries and support of Coatings and Sealants, including: 1. Order Fulfillment and Material Handling: Sourcing, storing, and delivering all required coatings and sealants (see attached list). This includes meeting a strict four (4) hour delivery timeline for urgent requirements and handling specialized materials, such as Premixed Frozen Material (PFM) requiring transit at -80F. The contractor must maintain a minimum of 85% shelf life for all products upon delivery. The contractor will also be responsible for managing shelf-life and ensuring proper storage and handling of the products prior to delivery. 2. FMS-3600 Coating Management: For this specialized product, implementing a lock and key ITAR-compliant storage system and maintaining rigorous chain of custody for the material. 3. Technical Assistance: Providing technical assistance that includes rapid response (within one business day) to material failures, on-site technical support during monthly visits, product change support, and quality audit reporting. 4. Online Ordering System: Furnishing a secure, web-based ordering and tracking system with real-time visibility of lead times and minimum stock levels (MSLS). 5. Ramp-Up Plan: Executing a ramp-up plan to achieve full performance readiness within eight (8) months of contract award. The anticipated contract will be a Firm Fixed Priced (FFP) IDIQ to include an 8-month ramp up period, a 5-year ordering period, and a 6-month allowance for remaining deliveries on the back end. Total period of performance is anticipated to be 6 years and 2 months. This is a total small business set-aside. The Government anticipates awarding a single contract. All interested small businesses are encouraged to respond to this solicitation. The Government intends to award a single contract resulting from the solicitation to the responsible offeror whose proposal represents the best value to the Government. This effort requires Contractors to be CMMC level 2 self-certified, therefore if you are not currently level 2 certified and are interested in this requirement you will need to begin the process to become level 2 certified immediately. Contract period of performance dates on the solicitation are estimates and are subject to change according to when the effort gets awarded. title: Special Notice: Global Tactical Edge Acquisition Directorate (G-TEAD) � Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System (C-UAS) Fly-Away Kit (SETAF-AF ACE 27-01
description: 1. Purpose & Overview The U.S. Army Southern European Task Force, Africa (SETAF-AF), in coordination with the Global Tactical Edge Acquisition Directorate (G-TEAD), is publishing this Special Notice to alert industry to an upcoming external market research and capability-vetting opportunity administered via the U.S. Army FUZE xTech C-UAS Prize Competition. This is an informational Special Notice only. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), a formal Request for Information (RFI), or an invitation for bid. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service, nor will the Government reimburse any costs incurred in responding to this notice. The official prize competition, including all cash prize allocations, evaluation criteria, and challenge rules, is administered exclusively through the external xTech platform. All capability white papers and entries must be submitted through the external xTech portal to be eligible for competition entry. 2. Capability Focus Areas SETAF-AF and G-TEAD are seeking mature, rapidly deployable (TRL 6+) C-UAS capabilities addressing Group 1�3 sUAS threats in austere environments across five capability areas: Capability 1 (Consolidated Capability): Single air-cargo pallet / transit-case integrated kit with common power distribution and operator interface. Capability 2 (Detection & Identification): Passive and active sensors detecting non-emitting Group 1/2 sUAS (at 1.5 km or greater) and Group 3 (at 8 km or greater). Capability 3 (Kinetic Defeat): Defeat mechanisms requiring no spectrum or navigation approvals, minimizing collateral risk near active civilian or military airfields. Capability 4 (Non-Kinetic Defeat): Directional/omni-directional RF denial and navigation disruption with integrated deconfliction safeguards. Capability 5 (Passive Protection): Zero-power, zero-spectrum signature reduction (visual, thermal, radar) and decoy integration. 3. Regulatory & Technical Disclaimers Operational & Spectrum Approvals: Technical capabilities or controls built into proposed systems do not confer legal authority to emit, jam, or disrupt spectrum or airspace. Any future operational employment or physical testing remains subject to separate U.S. Government, host-nation, spectrum, safety, and airspace approvals. Supply Chain & Domestic Preference: Solutions must comply with NDAA � 848, � 817, and � 889, as well as the American Security Drone Act (ASDA). Any organic UAS must have Blue UAS clearance; Trade Agreements Act (TAA) compliance applies to all other components. Proprietary Data: The Government will protect properly marked proprietary information. Vendors are solely responsible for marking proprietary or competition-sensitive data. Authorities Used: 10 U.S.C. � 4114 � Selection of contractors for prototype projects 10 U.S.C. � 4022 � Prototype projects 10 U.S.C. � 4023 � Procurement for experimental purposes 10 U.S.C. � 4001 � Research and development 10 U.S.C. � 4021 � Other Transaction Authority (OTA) 10 U.S.C. � 3458 � Authority to acquire innovative commercial products and commercial services using general solicitation competitive procedures 15 U.S.C. � 3703 � Technology innovation partnerships 15 U.S.C. � 638 � Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) Programs 4. Vendor Submission Guidance (External xTech Portal) To participate in the external xTech capability review, vendors must submit their capability packages through the designated xTech portal. Do not submit package files through SAM.gov or via email to the contracting office. As detailed in the full xTech announcement, submissions must consist of: White Paper: A maximum of four (4) pages in PDF format detailing how the technology maps to one or more of the five Capability Areas. Accompanying Video: An optional, but highly recommended, five (5) minute maximum video demonstrating the system in operation or explaining its deployment scheme. System TRL Certification: Self-certification of Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 6 or above. Submission Portal Link: https://usg.valideval.com/teams/xtech-cuas/signup Official RFI Document: https://xtech.army.mil/ White Paper Submission Deadline: November 17, 2026, at 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET)

title: Directors and Officers insurance (D&O insurance) for EIFO - primary layer
description: Introduction to EIFO: EIFO was established as an independent public enterprise pursuant to Act No. 871 of 21 June 2022 on Denmark’s Export and Investment Fund (the “EIFO Act”). EIFO serves as Denmark’s official export credit agency (ECA) and national promotional bank (NPB). EIFO provides financing and risk capital with the aim of promoting growth and innovation in Danish businesses, supporting their export and internationalisation activities, and contributing to a sustainable and green transition. As a state-owned financial institution with a global perspective and an AAA credit rating, EIFO offers a range of financial solutions to Danish companies and their international customers and partners. EIFO also invests directly in companies and in funds, including funds focused on innovation and technology. EIFO complements the private market by providing financing and risk capital in areas where private market participants are generally unable or unwilling to undertake the relevant activity due to its nature, scale or associated risk. In this capacity, EIFO supports Danish companies at different stages of development, ranging from start-ups and SMEs with growth ambitions to established export companies seeking financing for international expansion and entry into new markets. In cooperation with Danish and international banks, financial institutions, leasing companies and investors, EIFO provides, among other things, loans, guarantees and various forms of equity financing to Danish companies across all stages of their development. For further information about EIFO, please see the following website: https://eifo.dk/ Tender: This tender concerns a contract for EIFO’ Directors and Officers insurance (D&O insurance) covering the primary layer. Please refer to the tender material for information about capacity (limits and retention), risk assessment, and the time and activity plan. The information will not be shared publicly but can be obtained directly from the contact persons. Questions are to be addressed to the contact person in writing as soon as possible and no later than November 10, 2026. Marsh will gather all questions in a Q&A document which will be provided to insurers as soon as possible. It will be updated along the process. The quoting deadline is November 17, 2026 (prolongation of deadline is NOT possible). • Marsh is handling the tender on behalf of EIFO. Contact person: Marcus Gramkow Marcus.Gramkow@Marsh.com Direct: +45 24493037 The quotes will be evaluated on the basis of the following combined criteria for award decision: Price and best possible terms and conditions. There will be done an overall evaluation of the accumulated advantages and disadvantages of the received quotes in respect of pricing and terms/conditions

description: Tjeldbergodden transformatorstasjon ligger nordøst i Aure kommune på Nordmøre. Nærmeste nabo er Equinor sitt prosessanlegg, rett vest for den nye stasjonstomten. Ny transformatorstasjon skal øst for tomten og industriområdet til Equinor Tjeldbergodden og utformes med: - 132kV AIS-anlegg - En ny transformator - To transformatorsjakter - Stasjonsbygg for 22kV AIS-anlegg - Forberedt for videre utvidelser med føringsveier, fundamenter, osv. Mindre endringer av [OH1] eksisterende vei for tilpasning for massetransport og transformatortransport. - Komplett VA-anlegg og grøfter på tomt med tilknytning til offentlig nett. Eventuelt privat nett (Equinor) for overvannshåndtering. - Komplett utomhusarbeid innenfor stasjontomtens område. - Stasjonsbygg og plasstøpte transformatorceller i betong. - Plasstøpte betongfundamenter for kontroll- og apparatanlegg. Stålstativer inngår i annen entreprise. - Etablering av komplett utendørs jordingsanlegg med maskenett, ringjord, oppstikk, osv. for jording av alle utendørs apparatanlegg og transformatorer. - Komplett svakstrøm elektroinstallasjoner for stasjonsbygg og utendørs med blant annet belysning, adgangskontroll/monitorering og kameraovervåkning. [OH2] - Komplett sikring med områdesiking, skallsikring, sonesikring, EMP-sikring og elektronisk sikring av det planlagte anlegget iht. prosjekterte løsninger og sikringsnotat. - Komplett VVS-installasjoner for stasjonsbygg. - ITB koordinering i henhold til NS 3935. - Prøvedrift og oppfølging i driftsfase i henhold til NS 6450.

title: Germany – Architectural and related services – Fassadensanierung - Objektplanung
description: Das Rathaus Harburg wurde 1889-1892 in der damals selbstständigen Stadt Harburg, im Stil der Neorenaissance nach Plänen von Christoph Hehl errichtet. Das Objekt ist als Einzelbaudenkmal in der hamburgischen Denkmalliste (ID26261) eingetragen. Geplant ist es eine Fassadensanierung vorzunehmen, hierfür ist vor Baubeginn die denkmalrechtliche Genehmigung einzuholen. Das Rathaus Harburg ist Sitz der Bezirksverwaltung sowie der Bezirksversammlung und befindet sich am Harburger Rathausplatz 1, 21073 Hamburg. Im Jahr 2020 wurde bereits für eine Fassadensanierung eine detaillierte Bestandsaufnahme sowie die LP 1- anteilig 3 durch ein Planungsbüro erstellt. Die Unterlagen werden bei dem Vergabeverfahren zur Verfügung gestellt. Im Zuge der Sanierung werden die verschiedenen Fassadenseiten abschnittsweise saniert. Hierfür werden die einzelnen Fassadenseiten eingerüstet und Maurer- und Putzarbeiten, Stuckateurleistungen (Figuren, Gesimse etc.) und vereinzeln Malerarbeiten vorgenommen. Weiterhin Bedarf es die vorhandenen Fenster zu sanieren und in Teilbereichen erforderliche Dach- und Klempnerarbeiten vorzunehmen. Hinzu kommt, dass die Baumaßnahmen im laufenden Betrieb durchgeführt werden müssen. Für die Planung der Baumaßnahme werden alle erforderlichen Gutachten (Geologen, Statiker, Dach) sowie eine Schadstoffanalyse eingeholt. Für die Fassadensanierung ist vor Baubeginn die denkmalrechtliche Genehmigung einzuholen. Die benötigten Planungsleistungen des Vorhabens werden stufenweise beauftragt. Die Beauftragung erfolgt dabei in 4 Stufen, wobei sich die einzelnen Leistungsphasen wie folgt auf die Stufen aufteilen: Stufe 1: Leistungsphasen 1 – 4 (Grundlagenermittlung, Vor- und Entwurfsplanung, Genehmigungs-planung) Stufe 2: Leistungsphasen 5 – 7 (Ausführungsplanung, Vorbereitung der Vergabe, Mitwirkung bei der Vergabe) Stufe 3: Leistungsphase 8 (Objektüberwachung – Bauüberwachung und Dokumentation) Stufe 4: Leistungsphase 9 (Objektbetreuung). Mit dem Zuschlag wird die Stufe 1 beauftragt. Die Beauftragung der weiteren Leistungsphasen erfolgt stufenweise und optional.

buyer: Stadtholding Landau in der Pfalz GmbH
title: Germany – Architectural and related services – Modernisierung und Sanierung des Freizeitbades / Hallenbades "La Ola" in Landau, Los 1 - Objektplanung Gebäude und Freianlagen
description: Die Stadtholding Landau in der Pfalz GmbH beabsichtigt die Modernisierung und Sanierung des Freizeitbades / Hallenbades "La Ola" in Landau. Im Rahmen dessen soll die Vergabe der Planungsleistungen erfolgen. Die Gesamtmaßnahme wird in zwei Bauabschnitten realisiert. Der 1. Bauabschnitt umfasst die Sanierung des bestehenden Schwimmbades (Bereich Schwimmer- und Lehrschwimmbecken) einschließlich des Anbaus eines weiteren Lehrschwimmbeckens sowie der Gebäudetechnik (Neubau eines Technikanbaus), ferner die Erneuerung des Umkleide- und Sanitärbereichs einschließlich Verwaltung und der zugehörigen Dachflächen. Der 2. Bauabschnitt umfasst die Erneuerung und Neugestaltung des Erlebnisbereichs (Badehalle mit Wellenbecken) einschließlich Foyer, Gastronomie und Außenanlagen sowie die Sanierung der Dachflächen über dem Erlebnis- und Gastronomiebereich. Gegenstand des vorliegenden Vergabeverfahrens ist ausschließlich Los 1 (Objektplanung Gebäude und Freianlagen). Die weiteren Lose - Tragwerksplanung (§ 51 HOAI), Technische Ausrüstung HLS und Wassertechnik sowie Technische Ausrüstung Elektro (jeweils § 55 HOAI) - werden nachfolgend vergeben. Die Baukosten der beiden Bauabschnitte sind der Leistungsbeschreibung zu entnehmen. Die Bauabschnitte werden honorarrechtlich als gesonderte Objekte behandelt und getrennt abgerechnet. Zur Absicherung der Finanzierung beabsichtigt die Auftraggeberin, sich an laufenden Förderprogrammen zu beteiligen; der Auftragnehmer hat die Auftraggeberin bei der Beantragung der Förderung zu unterstützen. Fördermittel sollen insbesondere aus den jeweils aktuellen Bundesförderprogrammen in Anspruch genommen werden. Die Planung ist von Beginn an so auszurichten, dass die Fördervoraussetzungen, insbesondere die geforderten energetischen Mindeststandards, eingehalten werden. Grundsätzlich ist eine zügige Umsetzung vorgesehen. Die Fertigstellung des 1. Bauabschnitts einschließlich Inbetriebnahme des Bades ist voraussichtlich spätestens bis zum 31.12.2030 geplant.

title: Germany – Facade work – Fassadenarbeiten
description: Bei dem geplanten Bauvorhaben handelt es sich im Rahmen der Modernisierungsmaßnahmen der Grundschule Michendorf sowie des angegliederten Hortgebäudes um eine energetische Sanierung der Gebäudehülle. Die Schulgebäude umfassen die Bauteile Haus 1, Haus 2 und den dazwischenliegenden Verbindungsbau. Bei diesen Gebäuden findet eine Dachsanierung sowie eine Sanierung der Fassaden inkl. Fensteraustausch und Ertüchtigung der Bauwerksabdichtung statt. Beim Hortgebäude ist die Ertüchtigung Sanierung der Dachfläche vorgesehen. Bestand Die energetisch zu sanierenden Objekte wurden abschnittsweise in den 1990er Jahren errichtet. Der Verbinder wurde Anfang der 2010er Jahre errichtet. Es besteht kein Denkmalschutz. Die Gebäude sind in Massivbauweise errichtet. Gem. der Bestandsunterlangen wurden die Außenwände mit 30cm starken Porotonsteinen ausgeführt, wobei der Sockelbereich mit 24cm starken Porotonsteinen und einer zusätzlichen Sockeldämmung ausgeführt wurde. Die Flachdächer von Haus 1, Haus 2 und Hortgebäude verfügen über eine Gefälledämmung mit innenliegender Dachentwässerung. Der Verbindungsbau verfügt über ein Pultdach als Holzkonstruktion mit Tragschale aus Stahltrapezblech. Bauzeitlich wurden Isolierglasfenster, zum Teil mit Raffstoreanlagen, verbaut.

description: The "Programme d'appui au développement durable et intégré en périphérie des aires protégées" (PADDI+) is cofinanced by the European Union and the German Federal Ministry of Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit GmbH (GIZ), in collaboration with the Ministère de l'Environnement et du Développement Durable (MEDD). The program aims to reduce the pressures on protected areas by promoting the sustainable and integrated development of communities living around national parks, as an alternative to the illegal exploitation of natural resources in protected areas. The budget of the program is EUR 34.500.000, with an implementation period of 81 months (07.2024 to 02.2031). The program is structured around four outputs: i) management of ecosystem services, ii) decentralized environmental governance, iii) development of productive landscapes and iv) creation of green jobs. PADDI+ is supporting local communities living around seven protected areas (i.e. Andohahela, Ankarafantsika, Ankarana, Analamerana, Marolambo, Midongy du Sud and Montagne d'Ambre).

title: Hurtig multiplex PCR-paneler (CSF, Fæces og luftveier) til Helse Møre og Romsdal HF
description: Anskaffelsens formål er å anskaffe reagenser og instrumenter til hurtig, syndrombasert multiplex PCR-diagnostikk for spinalvæske (CNS), fæces (gastrointestinal) og luftveisprøver. Multiplexpaneler gir rask og bred mikrobiologisk diagnostikk, og er spesielt nyttige i akutte kliniske situasjoner hvor rask diagnose er viktig for videre behandling og eventuell isolasjon.Avdeling for medisinsk mikrobiologi leverer laboratorieundersøkelser innen medisinsk mikrobiologi til sykehusene og primærhelsetjenesten i Møre og Romsdal, og har virksomhet med seksjoner ved Sjukehuset Nordmøre og Romsdal (SNR) Hjelset og ved Ålesund sjukehus. Avdelingen arbeider tett med kliniske miljøer og yter både analysetjenester og faglig rådgivning knyttet til diagnostikk, videre utredning og behandling av infeksjonssykdommer. Avdelingen er akkreditert etter NS-EN ISO 15189, og anskaffelsen skal bidra til å opprettholde høy kvalitet, robuste arbeidsprosesser og moderne instrumentpark for rask og bred mikrobiologisk diagnostikk. Det skal leveres to instrumenter: Ett instrument til laboratoriet i Ålesund og ett instrument til laboratoriet på SNR (Hjelset). Anskaffelsen skal også inneholde opsjon på ett nytt instrument som kan plasseres ved sykehuset i Volda.Instrumentene skal være leverandørens eiendom i hele avtaleperioden. Leveransen skal inkludere montering/installasjon, IQ/OQ der dette er relevant, valideringsstøtte og opplæring av superbrukere/ fullservice i hele avtaleperioden. Løsningen skal støtte overføring av data og analysesvar til Helseplattformen.

Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere: * Demontage und fachgerechte Entsorgung der bestehenden Anhebevorrichtungen, Druckluftsysteme, Rohrleitungen, Armaturen und Nebenanlagen; * Revision der bestehenden Anhebe- und Bremszylinder; * Lieferung, Montage und Inbetriebsetzung neuer Rohrleitungen, Armaturen, Druckluftsystem und Sensoren; * Ersatz der bestehenden manuellen Anhebe-Pumpe; * Durchführung der erforderlichen Funktions- und Dichtheitsprüfungen; * Erstellung und Übergabe der Revisions-, Prüf- und Anlagendokumentation. title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source - Acadia Contract Extension
description: Under the authority of RFO 6.103-1, the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) seeks to issue a contract extension for the ACADIA requirements under contract number HM047619C0002 to ensure continuity of services currently being provided until the competitive acquisition of the follow-on contract (ACADIA II) is awarded. The ACADIA contract provides Test and Evaluation (T&E) services in the form of image quality and utility assurance services, production and maintenance of data quality standards and scales, technical support and management of an independent enterprise verification testing environment, and development/operation/maintenance of automated test tools in both cloud and DevOps environments. No competition is being sought at this time. This notice is in accordance with RFO 5.101, and is not a request for competitive proposals. A solicitation will not be posted. However, any responsible sources that believes it can meet this requirement may submit a capability statement in sufficient detail with supporting evidence to demonstrate the ability to comply with the requirement via unclassified email to the points of contact (POCs), which shall be taken into consideration by the NGA.
